models.title: Linear Regression
models.description: Straight line model. Fast & simple. Best for linear trends.

topics.title: Overview
topics.summary: What is Linear Regression and when to use it.
topics.content: Linear regression fits a straight line to data using least squares. It's a fundamental technique for predicting a continuous target.

topics.title: Formula
topics.content: The model is y = mx + c where m is slope and c is intercept. Coefficients are learned from data.

topics.title: Example
topics.summary: A small example dataset and prediction.
topics.content: Given points, the model estimates the best-fit line. Use libraries like scikit-learn or implement with numpy.

models.title: Multiple Linear Regression
models.description: Uses multiple features. More realistic. Still linear.

topics.title: Overview
topics.summary: Extend linear regression to multiple features.
topics.content: Multiple linear regression models a target as a linear combination of several input features.

topics.title: Assumptions
topics.content: Linearity, independence, homoscedasticity, normality of errors are common assumptions.

topics.title: Example
topics.summary: A real-world example using multiple inputs.
topics.content: Predicting house prices from area, bedrooms, and age of property.

models.title: Decision Tree
models.description: Rule-based splits. Easy to understand. Non-linear model.

topics.title: Overview
topics.summary: How decision trees partition the feature space.
topics.content: Decision trees split features by thresholds to create simple decision rules.

topics.title: Advantages
topics.content: Interpretable, handles non-linear relationships, works with mixed data types.

topics.title: Limitations
topics.content: Prone to overfitting and can be unstable to small changes in data.

models.title: Random Forest
models.description: Many trees combined. High accuracy. Reduces overfitting.

topics.title: Overview
topics.content: Random Forest averages predictions from many decorrelated trees to reduce variance.

topics.title: Tuning
topics.content: Number of trees, max depth, and features per split influence performance and cost.

topics.title: Use Cases
topics.content: Tabular data problems with complex interactions and when interpretability is secondary.

models.title: Grid Search
models.description: Tries multiple combinations to find the best model.

topics.title: Overview
topics.content: Grid search exhaustively evaluates parameter combinations to find the best performing set.

topics.title: Alternatives
topics.content: Random search and Bayesian optimization can be more efficient for large spaces.

topics.title: Practical Tips
topics.summary: Best practices when using grid search.
topics.content: Use cross-validation, scale data, and limit search ranges to reasonable values.
